name: @mapled/mcp
stderr: MAPLED_MCP_TOKEN is missing. Create one in Mapled on a computer: project → Integrations → Connect with AI → Other ways to connect → Generate token → Copy config. Connect with AI shows only while no AI client is connected: if a connection whose token was lost is listed, press Revoke in its row first. The token starts with mcp_live_; a delivery key (mk_live_) is the wrong one.
